user.title: Onelap Vehicle Tracker
user.description: Paste your Onelap share link or tracking id. Open the Onelap app, share a device, and copy the link (looks like https://r.onelap.in/#/shared?tid=XXXXXX).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Onelap. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_tracking_id: That tracking id / share link did not return any devices. Make sure the link is correct and sharing is still enabled.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Onelap share link is already set up.
